name: Sick Fab LLC
old_description: Whether you need your item augmented or a custom fabrication from scratch, Sick Fab will exceed your expectations. We use state of the art equipment like our CNC Plasma machine which cuts metal into precise measurements that the human hand is incapable of matching. Our team of skilled fabricators then bend, weld, and design anything your project may require. All of our welds and projects come with a lifetime guarantee! Let us show you why we are the top rated Las Vegas Metal Fabrication shop on Google.
about:
Sick Fabrication LLC operates from a shop at 6405 Pine Street in Las Vegas, Nevada. The business was launched in 2003 by Josey Martin, who began welding as a teenager and had been building sand rails since childhood. Martin’s 20-plus years of hands-on experience anchor the company’s reputation in the local market.

The shop provides metal fabrication and welding services including MIG, TIG, and stick welding on steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and chromoly. Equipment includes a CNC water plasma table, a CNC plasma cutting table, a milling machine, and a press brake capable of bending material up to 1/2 inch thick and 16 inches long, or up to 1/4 inch thick and 96 inches long. The crew of certified welders handles prototype work, custom one-off projects, and larger production runs of identical parts.

Customers span automotive off-road builders needing roll cages, bumpers, and light bars; construction firms requiring embed plates, handrails, gates, bridges, and shade structures; arts and entertainment clients such as Burning Man art cars, art installations, and theatrical scenery; trade-show exhibitors; firearms manufacturers for milling work; and accessibility contractors modifying homes for handicap access. The company also holds NHTSA Domestic Manufacturer (Final Stage) certification to produce truck beds and trailers.

Sick Fabrication distinguishes itself with a lifetime guarantee on all welds and finished projects, emphasizing precision from its CNC plasma systems that exceed manual capabilities. The Nevada-licensed shop stresses its certified welder team and the owner’s deep fabrication background as the foundation for meeting diverse custom demands.
